hold_text: pr-landing R5 refuses self-landing on src/web/api/routers/diag.py, Tier-2 BY PATH, and the guard is right. This is a one-line bug fix to a route I shipped in #11560 that raises TypeError on EVERY request, so it needs a merge click and is blocking the MI-221 closed-PnL tie-breaker the operator is waiting on.
why: FIXES A DEFECT I SHIPPED IN #11560. /api/diag/bybit_raw_closed_pnl called run_account_read(fn, acc, symbol=..., start_ms=..., end_ms=...); run_account_read(fn, *args) is POSITIONAL-ONLY because it forwards to loop.run_in_executor, which takes no kwargs. The route therefore raised TypeError on EVERY request and could never return a record — observed on the first live query at 2026-09-09T16:06:02Z, read_state 'could_not_look', error 'TypeError: run_account_read() got an unexpected keyword argument symbol'. THE FIX binds the keyword-only window with functools.partial BEFORE the executor hop. VERIFIED BY A STANDALONE REPRODUCTION of run_account_read's exact contract: the kwargs form raises the identical TypeError, the partial form returns the bound window correctly. The route module cannot be imported in this sandbox (fastapi absent — the same reason the repo splits route tests from accessor tests), so the added route test runs in CI, not here; the mechanic itself was proven locally. WHY IT SHIPPED GREEN, filed as BL-20260909-A-DIAG-ROUTE-PASSED-KWARGS-THROUGH-A-POSITIONAL-ONLY-EXECUTOR-HOP-AND-ONLY-A-LIVE-REQUEST-COULD-CATCH-IT: 7 accessor assertions passed because they call the accessor DIRECTLY, and an accessor-level test cannot reach the route's executor-hop seam BY CONSTRUCTION; guards and pytest-run were both green while the route raised on every request. The new tests/test_diag_closed_pnl_route_wiring.py closes it for this route by stubbing run_account_read with a POSITIONAL-ONLY fake that reproduces loop.run_in_executor's contract, so a kwargs regression fails in test exactly as it did live; it also pins that run_account_read has no VAR_KEYWORD parameter, and that a raising hop still grades could_not_look rather than an empty record list. CREDIT WHERE DUE, stated honestly: the three-state design contained the blast radius — because a raised call is recorded as could_not_look and never folded into no_rows, the broken route reported 'we could not look' instead of 'the venue booked no close', and on this investigation that distinction was load-bearing, since an empty result would have been read as the venue having no record of trade 5471's close, the OPPOSITE finding and a P1 of its own. The state design worked; the wiring did not. No behaviour changes for any other route or reader; no order path touched. No order was placed, modified or cancelled on bybit_2 or any account; every venue call is a GET.
